concerns.analysis: The source PDF contains two critical data visualizations (pie charts) on pages 14 and 15 representing the department's 'Budget Expenditures' and 'Budget Funding Sources' percentages. In the HTML output, both images are missing and have been replaced by HTML comments indicating 'image without data'. This results in a complete loss of the financial data points.
